title: AGCP Common Types
description: Shared JSON Schema definitions actively required by the AGCP v2.0 schema set. Canonical domain objects and result/reference definitions are owned by their assigned DS schemas; backward-compatibility aliases are not retained.
rtm_mapping_basis: RTM-00005 / CR-005 maps the canonical provenance wire schema and IF-001. RTM-00042, RTM-00052, RTM-00064, and RTM-00066 map the generic algorithm-explicit content-digest contract for replay, Canonical State, evidence, and receipt integrity.
notes: Canonical AGCP shared-definition library. Provenance is synchronized with the normative wire format. P1-12 binds every supported content-digest algorithm to an exact lowercase-hexadecimal output length and deprecates algorithm-implicit hash_hex for new contracts. Reverse dependency metadata remains synchronized to the active graph.

title: AGCP ErrorResponse
description: Standard IF-001 error response. Public protected-resource lookup failures use RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND. Pre-governance throttling uses REQUEST_THROTTLED with HTTP 429 and Retry-After. Processing capacity unavailable before governance begins uses CAPACITY_UNAVAILABLE with HTTP 503. These transport/application errors are not Governance Outcomes.
rtm_mapping_basis: Existing GitHub_File references in RTM-1.6; DS_ID populated in RTM-1.7.
notes: v2.0.4 P1-03/P1-09 correction: public 404 is normalized to RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND; REQUEST_THROTTLED requires 429 plus Retry-After; CAPACITY_UNAVAILABLE uses 503; transport/service conditions are not Governance Outcomes.

title: AGCP Implementation Metadata Response
description: Canonical DS-003 implementation metadata response. It advertises immutable AGCP baseline identity and digest, implementation profile identity and digest, schema and validator set integrity, active governance version, registries, conformance and capability claims, IF-001 contract identity, and optional public-safe deployment binding.
rtm_mapping_basis: Direct implementation-conformance discovery mapping for claimed AGCP semantics and cross-implementation interoperability; DS-003 exposes explicit release, profile, schema-set, registry, conformance, capability, and interface evidence.
notes: v2.0.4 P1-14/P1-17 correction: metadata advertises immutable baseline and profile digests, schema and validator-set integrity, active governance version, IF-001 identity, and optional public-safe deployment binding.

title: AGCP Tenant Governance Record
description: Canonical, attributable, versioned, integrity-protected Tenant governance record. DS-004 records the authoritative Tenant operational state and state version, append-only state history and transition basis, active and historical Governance Configuration versions, Tenant Governance Evidence, explicit Tenant and Governance Domain Isolation controls, registry bindings, and complete record integrity. It does not itself establish authority at commitment, authorize execution, or override Canonical State. Tenant/domain isolation extends through authoritative identity/authorization qualification, Governance Realization, PEP Profile selection, Enforcement Context, and PEP-mediated target authority where those mechanisms are in scope.
rtm_mapping_basis: Direct implementation of Tenant operational-state enforcement and Tenant/Governance Domain Isolation, including current-state checks at evaluation and commitment, cross-tenant visibility/authority/execution/policy/evidence isolation, and attributable state/configuration history.
notes: Comprehensively updated for AGCP v2.0. DS-004 now records authoritative Tenant state and version, append-only attributable state history and transition basis, active and historical Governance Configuration versions, Tenant Governance Evidence, explicit isolation controls, registry bindings, provenance, signature, digest, and replay material. Unrestricted metadata and the shared Tenant-state alias were removed.

title: Policy Evaluation Module Artifact
description: Canonical attributable, versioned, integrity-protected representation of a Policy Evaluation Module (PEM) artifact used to evaluate compiled governance policy semantics. DS-005 binds the module to source policies, Governance Configuration, deterministic Compilation Context, validated dependencies, Governance Artifact Lineage, Constitutional Validation, Governance Omission Analysis, Governance Self-Protection, Controlled Governance Activation, and Governance Version without itself establishing authority at commitment, determining Commit-Bound Admissibility, authorizing execution, activating governance, or committing a transition. Policy Evaluation Modules implement deterministic Governance Decision Function/PDP evaluation. They may consume DS-053 qualified identity/authorization input through declared schema bindings but do not perform Governance Realization or PEP enforcement.
rtm_mapping_basis: Contextual and implementation-specific realization of Governance Compilation, deterministic Compilation Context, Compiled Governance Artifact validation, protected-governance preservation, omission analysis, self-protection, and Controlled Governance Activation for Policy Evaluation Modules.
notes: Comprehensively updated for AGCP v2.0. DS-005 owns the canonical Policy Evaluation Module artifact and integrity-bound reference. It records deterministic runtime and interface contracts; source policy, configuration, registry, compilation-context, build, dependency, lineage, validation, self-protection, activation, Governance Version, evidence, integrity, and replay bindings without itself establishing authority, admissibility, execution authorization, activation, or commitment.

title: Governance Policy Artifact
description: Canonical, independently identifiable, attributable, versioned, integrity-protected representation of governance policy intent applicable to a defined Tenant, governance domain, and effective scope. It declares deterministic policy semantics, required governance inputs, authority, evidence, Canonical State, lifecycle, composite-governance, refusal-path, escalation, and commit requirements; binds those semantics to Governance Configuration; and references the DS-042 Compiled Governance Artifact and DS-043 Controlled Governance Activation records that make validated compiled policy authoritative. The policy artifact does not itself establish authority at commitment, determine Commit-Bound Admissibility, authorize execution, activate governance, or commit a transition.
rtm_mapping_basis: Direct mapping to CR-007 and relationship-specific contextual mappings to governance compilation, protected-policy preservation, omission analysis, and self-modification isolation requirements in RTM-1.30.
notes: Comprehensively updated for v2.0 as the canonical policy-intent artifact. Owns the integrity-bound policy reference used by active schemas and directly references DS-041, DS-042, and DS-043.

title: Governance Constraint Artifact
description: Canonical attributable, versioned, integrity-protected representation of a governance constraint. DS-007 preserves source lineage, deterministic constraint semantics, protected or constitutional classification, Governance Configuration binding, compilation and validation evidence, Governance Version, Controlled Governance Activation, and non-weakening semantics without itself establishing authority at commitment, determining Commit-Bound Admissibility, authorizing execution, activating governance, or committing a transition.
rtm_mapping_basis: Direct mapping to CR-063 and relationship-specific contextual mappings to governance compilation, constitutional validation and preservation, Governance Self-Protection, omission analysis, and self-modification isolation requirements in RTM-1.32.
notes: Comprehensively updated for v2.0. DS-007 owns the canonical integrity-bound constraint reference used by active schemas; generic shared aliases and unconstrained metadata were removed. Reverse schema dependency metadata synchronized to the active forward schema_dependencies graph in Schema Catalog 1.0.44.

title: Governance Invariant Definition
description: Canonical attributable, versioned, integrity-protected definition of an AGCP governance invariant. DS-008 preserves source specification and governance lineage, deterministic invariant semantics, protected or constitutional classification, enforcement level, Governance Configuration binding, compilation and validation evidence, Governance Version, Controlled Governance Activation, and explicit non-weakening semantics without itself establishing authority at commitment, determining Commit-Bound Admissibility, authorizing execution, activating governance, or committing a transition.
rtm_mapping_basis: Direct mappings to hard-invariant failure, invariant-based Structural Refusal, required invariant references, and deterministic invariant evaluation; contextual mappings to Governance Compilation, Constitutional Validation, protected-invariant preservation, Governance Self-Protection, Governance Omission Analysis, and self-modification isolation.
notes: Comprehensively updated for AGCP v2.0 as the canonical invariant-definition artifact. DS-008 owns invariant identity, classification, enforcement level, integrity-bound references, deterministic semantics, source and artifact lineage, protected/constitutional non-weakening controls, compilation validation, controlled activation, Governance Version, evidence, and replay material.

title: Governance Exception Artifact
description: Canonical attributable, versioned, integrity-protected governance exception artifact. DS-009 permits only narrowly scoped, time-bounded, authority-backed and externally approved modification of ordinary exceptionable constraint evaluation. It cannot override protected or constitutional constraints, cannot override governance invariants, cannot establish authority at commitment, and is authoritative for runtime use only after DS-042 compilation and DS-043 Controlled Governance Activation.
rtm_mapping_basis: Relationship-specific contextual mappings to Governance Compilation, Constitutional Validation and Preservation, Governance Self-Protection, Governance Omission Analysis, and Governance Self-Modification Isolation requirements in RTM-1.34.
notes: Comprehensively updated for AGCP v2.0. DS-009 owns the canonical integrity-bound exception reference, restricts exceptions to ordinary exceptionable constraints, requires current authority and external approval, and prohibits protected/constitutional weakening, invariant override, scope amplification, bypass, and self-activation.

title: Governance Artifact View
description: Canonical externally observable, integrity-protected read model for a governance-significant artifact and its current compilation, validation, approval, activation, Governance Version, lineage, evidence, and lifecycle state. The view projects authoritative DS-041, DS-042, and DS-043 records without replacing or modifying them.
rtm_mapping_basis: Contextual read-model mapping to governance compilation, validation, self-protection, omission analysis, controlled activation, and self-modification isolation requirements.
notes: Comprehensively updated for v2.0 to project canonical DS-041, DS-042, and DS-043 state without duplicating or replacing authoritative records.

title: Governance Constraint Evaluation Result
description: Canonical, attributable, integrity-protected result of evaluating one DS-007 Governance Constraint Artifact for a specific Governed Action Proposal, Tenant, governance domain, target, evaluation horizon, Governance Version, and qualified governance-input set. DS-011 records applicability, deterministic condition evaluation, satisfied, violated, indeterminate, or not-applicable outcomes, resulting governance disposition, evidence, attribution, integrity, and replay material without itself authorizing execution or establishing authority at commitment.
rtm_mapping_basis: Direct and supporting mappings added for constraint-controlled authorization, governing-constraint identification, evidence integrity, attribution, replay, and deterministic evaluation.
notes: Comprehensively refactored for AGCP v2.0 with canonical Proposal, Constraint, Tenant/domain, target, evaluation horizon, Governance Version and Configuration, qualified-input digests, evidence, attribution, integrity, replay, and outcome-specific validation. Unrestricted metadata removed.

title: Governance Invariant Evaluation Result
description: Canonical, attributable, integrity-protected result of evaluating one DS-008 Governance Invariant Definition for a specific Governed Action Proposal, Proposal Identity, Tenant, governance domain, target, evaluation horizon, Governance Version, and qualified governance-input set. DS-012 records applicability, deterministic assertion evaluation, preserved, violated, indeterminate, or not-applicable outcomes, and explicitly identifies any resulting Structural Refusal, governed escalation, lifecycle effect, and Governance Evidence without itself authorizing execution or establishing authority at commitment.
rtm_mapping_basis: Semantic v2.0 mapping established during DS-012 comprehensive evaluation-result refactor.
notes: Canonical invariant-evaluation result with explicit Structural Refusal, escalation, lifecycle-effect, Governance Evidence, deterministic qualified-input binding, attribution, integrity, and replay semantics.

title: Proposal Submit Request
description: Normative transport wrapper for submitting one untrusted Proposal object to AGCP Proposal Qualification. The wrapper validates transport-envelope structure only. The proposal member is intentionally not constrained by DS-021 at transport validation time because DS-021 validation is a Proposal Qualification obligation and structural deficiencies must be capable of producing Structural Refusal rather than being converted into a transport-only error.
rtm_mapping_basis: Existing GitHub_File references in RTM-1.6; DS_ID populated in RTM-1.7.
notes: Transport-envelope-only submission wrapper. The proposal member is deliberately untyped at transport validation so DS-021 validation occurs inside Proposal Qualification and structurally invalid proposals can produce Structural Refusal.

title: Proposal View
description: Canonical externally observable view of a governed proposal. The view keeps authoritative Derived Lifecycle State separate from transient processing status and exposes canonical references to the proposal, context, state, authority, decisions, authorizations, commit attempts and results, evidence, receipts, refusals, composite-governance objects, enforcement, degradation, continuation, terminality, and replay-relevant history.
rtm_mapping_basis: Existing GitHub_File references in RTM-1.6; DS_ID populated in RTM-1.7.
notes: Step 5 refactor: authoritative lifecycle state is separated from transient processing status and the view now references canonical workflow and governance objects directly.

title: Governance Decision Result
description: Canonical, attributable, integrity-protected result produced by the Governance Decision Function after Proposal Qualification. The result binds the decision to the canonical proposal, target, Tenant, governance domain, policy and Governance Version, qualified Canonical State, qualified Governance Evidence, Authority Lineage, applicable constraints and invariants, approvals, evaluation horizon, and deterministic decision basis. Non-refusal outcomes require a DS-027 Governance Receipt; Structural Refusal requires a DS-028 Refusal Record. The Governance Decision Function realizes the PDP functional role; this result does not by itself establish commit-bound execution eligibility.
rtm_mapping_basis: Exact DS-to-requirement assignments derived from the authoritative RTM-1.47 DS_ID column; the catalog records the corresponding RTM_ID and CR_ID sets without omission or addition.
notes: Step 5 refactor: canonical decision basis, qualified state and evidence, authority, constraints, invariants, attribution, receipt, and refusal relationships are structurally represented. Catalog ARM and NS mappings synchronized from the authoritative DS-015 schema annotation. RTM/CR traceability synchronized to RTM-1.47 by adding RTM-00034 and CR-034.

title: Execution Authorization View
description: Canonical externally observable representation of an AGCP Execution Authorization. It binds an authorization outcome to the canonical proposal, Governance Decision Result, target, Tenant, governance domain, policy and Governance Version, qualified Canonical State, qualified evidence, Authority Lineage, lifecycle, scope, and validity conditions. Execution Authorization is eligibility evidence for Commit Boundary processing; it is neither authority at commitment nor permission to execute. The authorization is consumed by Governance Realization and remains subject to current Authority Re-Derivation, Commit-Bound Admissibility, and PEP mediation.
rtm_mapping_basis: Exact DS-to-requirement assignments derived from the authoritative RTM-1.47 DS_ID column; the catalog records the corresponding RTM_ID and CR_ID sets without omission or addition.
notes: Step 5 refactor: target, scope, lifecycle, validity, state, evidence, authority, consumption, attribution, and non-executable authorization semantics are structurally represented. RTM/CR traceability synchronized to RTM-1.47 by adding RTM-00010 and CR-010.

title: Commit Boundary Request
description: Canonical integrity-protected request that initiates Governance Realization / Commit Boundary processing for a previously authorized proposal. The caller supplies the proposal and Execution Authorization basis; the GRF independently establishes current authority, current qualified state/evidence, binding validity, PEP Profile selection, Enforcement Context, and enforcement readiness before invoking the PEP.
rtm_mapping_basis: Existing GitHub_File references in RTM-1.6; DS_ID populated in RTM-1.7.
notes: Step 5 refactor: Commit Boundary invocation now carries the complete canonical governance basis and DS-029 Enforcement Context.

title: Commit Boundary Result
description: Canonical attributable and integrity-protected result of Governance Realization, Commit-Bound Admissibility, Governance Enforcement Binding, and Policy Enforcement Point processing at the Commit Boundary. Commit Successful records acceptance of the exact governed transition through the protected enforcement path; it does not universally assert that asynchronous target execution has completed.
rtm_mapping_basis: Existing GitHub_File references in RTM-1.6; DS_ID populated in RTM-1.7.
notes: Step 5 refactor: Commit Boundary outcome now records canonical request, enforcement, executed subset, lifecycle effect, receipt, refusal, attribution, and replay material.

title: Governance Evidence
description: Canonical immutable Governance Evidence record. It contains typed evidence-item references, explicit governing-state, configuration, constraint and invariant references where applicable, explicit ordering, integrity digests, attributable provenance-chain continuity, qualification results, Governance Ledger references, and links to canonical governance outcomes. Raw or arbitrary evidence payloads are not normative content.
rtm_mapping_basis: Existing GitHub_File references in RTM-1.6; DS_ID populated in RTM-1.7.
notes: Governance Evidence explicitly carries governing Canonical State, Governance Configuration, constraint-evaluation and invariant-evaluation references on governance decision/authorization/commit paths, in addition to existing typed evidence and replay bindings.

title: Governed Action Proposal
description: Canonical domain schema for a governance-significant proposed transition submitted to AGCP runtime-governance evaluation. The object declares stable Proposal Identity, operational intent, target, requested effect, canonical Action Representation, associated Governance Context, provenance, temporal validity, and applicable composite-governance semantics through the canonical DS-035 Bind Set and DS-036 Governance Dependency Graph. A Governed Action Proposal is not execution and does not confer authority at commitment.
rtm_mapping_basis: Exact DS-to-requirement assignments derived from the authoritative RTM-1.47 DS_ID column; the catalog records the corresponding RTM_ID and CR_ID sets without omission or addition.
notes: Canonical Governed Action Proposal. Composite proposals now reference canonical DS-035 Bind Set policy/reference definitions and canonical DS-036 Governance Dependency Graph rather than local transitional composite definitions. RTM/CR traceability synchronized to RTM-1.47 by adding RTM-00008;RTM-00009 and CR-008;CR-009. Reverse schema dependency metadata synchronized to the active forward schema_dependencies graph in Schema Catalog 1.0.44.

title: Governance Context Envelope
description: Canonical domain schema for the attributable, versioned governance-relevant context associated with a Governed Action Proposal. The envelope preserves identity, tenant, policy, evidence, delegation, authority, lineage, target, lifecycle, risk, handoff, coordination, and outcome relationships needed for governance evaluation and continuity. Context may inform governance but is not authoritative Canonical State and cannot override it.
rtm_mapping_basis: Relationship-specific semantic review of context integrity, lineage, handoff, Canonical State non-override, evidence continuity, attribution, and coordination requirements; synchronized in RTM-1.9.
notes: Canonical Governance Context Envelope. Delegation, Authority Lineage, approval, refusal, qualified-evidence, and dependency-graph references resolve to their canonical DS schemas; inline Canonical State remains prohibited.

title: Canonical State
description: Canonical domain schema for the single qualified and authoritative governance representation of operational reality used for a defined evaluation horizon. Canonical State is resolved deterministically from qualified authoritative governance sources; is distinct from Governance Context, runtime observations, telemetry, local state, and agent belief; and provides the current state basis for admissibility, authority re-derivation, governance binding, continuation, replay, receipts, and refusal. State suitability is established by an integrity-bound reference to the independently traceable DS-032 State Qualification Result. The Governance Ledger is authoritative for recorded governance events, event ordering, and Derived Lifecycle State, but need not originate every governance-relevant fact incorporated into Canonical State.
rtm_mapping_basis: Relationship-specific semantic review of Canonical State availability, freshness, single-state conflict resolution, precedence over non-authoritative observations, and State Qualification; synchronized in RTM-1.10.
notes: Canonical State uses the qualification_result property to carry an integrity-bound DS-032 State Qualification Result reference constrained to outcome QUALIFIED. The former embedded top-level qualification result is not retained. Reverse schema dependency metadata synchronized to the active forward schema_dependencies graph in Schema Catalog 1.0.44.

title: Authority Lineage
description: Canonical domain schema for the complete, attributable, integrity-protected chain through which the evidentiary basis for authority is originated, delegated, approved, constrained, revoked, re-established, and validated for a specific proposed transition. Authority Lineage remains bound to Proposal Identity, target, tenant, governance domain, scope, lifecycle, validity, Canonical State, policy, and evidence. It supports deterministic reconstruction and Authority Re-Derivation but is not portable executable authority and does not itself constitute authority at commitment or permission to execute.
rtm_mapping_basis: Relationship-specific semantic review of verifiable delegation references, deterministic lineage integrity, mission/task continuity, delegation-chain completeness, attribution consistency, provenance continuity, recursive authority containment, and cross-domain authority isolation; synchronized in RTM-1.12.
notes: Implemented as the canonical evidentiary authority-chain object. It aggregates DS-025 delegation references, preserves origin, approval, mission/task, scope, revocation, subject eligibility, domain-segment, and replay-protection relationships, and remains evidence for Authority Re-Derivation rather than portable execution authority. Reverse schema dependency metadata synchronized to the active forward schema_dependencies graph in Schema Catalog 1.0.44.

title: Delegation Artifact
description: Canonical domain schema for an independently verifiable artifact recording bounded authority delegated from one governance principal to another. A Delegation Artifact preserves source authority, scope attenuation, validity, revocation controls, tenant and governance-domain boundaries, target binding, recursive-delegation limits, cross-domain escalation evidence, attribution, integrity, and lineage continuity. It is evidence used during Authority Re-Derivation and does not itself constitute unconditional authority at commitment or permission to execute.
rtm_mapping_basis: Relationship-specific semantic review of verifiable delegation references, deterministic artifact integrity, delegation-chain continuity, attribution consistency, provenance continuity, governed cross-domain transition, and recursive authority containment; synchronized in RTM-1.11.
notes: Implemented as an immutable delegation-evidence object. Current authority, revocation, expiration, subject eligibility, and commit-time admissibility are re-derived from current qualified governance inputs. DS-022 now uses the DS-025 reference definition. Authority Lineage references now resolve through canonical DS-024.

title: Governance Approval Artifact
description: Authoritative AGCP-created or AGCP-qualified canonical domain schema for an attributable, cryptographically verifiable governance artifact recording human or governed approval, cosignature, positive or negative adjudication, risk acceptance, cancellation, withdrawal, or participation in partial or completed quorum. The artifact is proposal-, lifecycle-, scope-, tenant-, target-, policy-, governance-version-, and validity-bound evidence. It may support lifecycle progression, Authority Re-Derivation, and Commit-Bound Admissibility, but does not itself constitute authority at commitment or permission to execute.
rtm_mapping_basis: Relationship-specific semantic mapping approved for approval, adjudication, quorum, expiration, cancellation, and escalation requirements in RTM-1.13.
notes: Authoritative DS-026 AGCP-created or AGCP-qualified Governance Approval Artifact. It requires artifact_origin=AGCP_CREATED_OR_QUALIFIED and is not accepted as IF-001 ingress. DS-016 remains permanently retired; DS-045 is the separate active submission schema.

title: Governance Receipt
description: Canonical attributable and integrity-protected record of a non-refusal AGCP governance result. A Governance Receipt binds a Governed Action Proposal and its qualified governance basis to the recorded decision, authorization, approval, deterministic adjudication, commitment, enforcement, execution outcome, lifecycle transition, continuation outcome, or governed re-evaluation result. It is governance evidence rather than a mere application response and does not itself create authority at commitment or permission to execute. Structural Refusal is documented through a Refusal Record, not this schema. A receipt records commitment and may reference a distinct DS-052 post-commit execution outcome; commitment and completed target execution are not assumed to be identical events.
rtm_mapping_basis: Relationship-specific semantic mapping approved for canonical-state, governing-constraint, integrity, attribution, replay, evidence-continuity, evidence-availability, and independent-verification receipt requirements in RTM-1.14.
notes: Authoritative DS-027 canonical Governance Receipt for non-refusal governance results. Structural Refusal remains exclusively documented by DS-028 Refusal Record.

title: Refusal Record
description: Canonical attributable, integrity-protected, ledger-recorded, and replay-verifiable record documenting Structural Refusal and the governance basis that prevented a proposed transition from becoming operationally real. A Refusal Record is distinct from a policy denial, authorization failure, commit failure, transport error, warning, score, recommendation, or audit note.
rtm_mapping_basis: Exact DS-to-requirement assignments derived from the authoritative RTM-1.47 DS_ID column; the catalog records the corresponding RTM_ID and CR_ID sets without omission or addition.
notes: Authoritative DS-028 canonical Refusal Record for Structural Refusal. Policy denial, authorization failure, commit failure, deferral, and re-evaluation remain non-refusal results unless a separate Structural Refusal is applied. RTM/CR traceability synchronized to RTM-1.47 by adding RTM-00009 and CR-009. Reverse schema dependency metadata synchronized to the active forward schema_dependencies graph in Schema Catalog 1.0.44.

title: Enforcement Context
description: Integrity-protected enforcement-facing context assembled by the Governance Realization Function for one exact commit-eligible governed transition. It binds the proposal, decision, Execution Authorization, current authority, current qualified state/evidence, target/action, PEP Profile and mapping, Governance Enforcement Binding, and PEP caller context without widening governance meaning.
rtm_mapping_basis: Relationship-specific semantic mapping approved for Enforcement Context availability, Enforcement Decision Integrity, and Governance Enforcement Binding in RTM-1.24.
notes: Canonical DS-029 Enforcement Context assembled from the completed qualified governance basis and supplied to a specific Policy Enforcement Point. It preserves Governance Enforcement Binding, supports fail-closed mismatch detection, and does not replace source governance objects or independently create authority, authorization, execution, or commitment.

title: Governance Binding Validation Result
description: Canonical, independently identifiable and traceable result of determining immediately before enforcement and commitment whether the proposal remains bound to the same governance decision, execution authorization, current proposal-specific authority, qualified evidence, target, Tenant, governance domain, policy, qualified Canonical State, Derived Lifecycle State, scope, validity window, Governance Version, and applicable composite bind conditions previously evaluated by governance. It prevents substitution, detachment, cross-tenant transfer, stale or mismatched input use, invalid replay, and ungoverned partial binding. A valid result permits Enforcement Context assembly and continued Commit-Bound Admissibility processing but does not itself authorize execution, establish authority, apply enforcement, or commit a transition.
rtm_mapping_basis: Relationship-specific semantic mapping approved for Governance Realization, composite pre-bind re-evaluation, and governed partial-binding continuity in RTM-1.23.
notes: Canonical DS-030 commit-time Governance Binding Validation result. It compares the previously evaluated binding with current qualified governance inputs across proposal, decision, authorization, authority, evidence, target, Tenant, policy, Canonical State, lifecycle, scope, validity, Governance Version, and composite bind conditions. It permits Enforcement Context assembly only when all applicable dimensions remain intact and does not itself authorize, enforce, or commit execution.

title: Resulting-State Validation Result
description: Canonical, independently identifiable and traceable result of validating before commitment that the state projected to result from one governed transition, a complete Bind Set, or an explicitly governed executable subset satisfies all applicable governance requirements. The result preserves constraints, invariants, dependency and coupling conditions, aggregate-state effects, qualified Canonical State, deterministic projection, attribution, integrity, and replay. It contributes to Commit-Bound Admissibility but does not establish authority, authorize execution, select an executable subset, or itself commit any transition.
rtm_mapping_basis: Relationship-specific semantic mapping approved for Governance Realization support and explicit determination that a complete or partial transition set preserves acceptable projected resulting state in RTM-1.21.
notes: Canonical DS-031 pre-commit Resulting-State Validation. It evaluates deterministic projected aggregate state for a single transition, complete Bind Set, or explicitly governed executable subset; preserves constraints, invariants, dependency and coupling conditions; and blocks commitment when the state is invalid or indeterminate. It is not authority, authorization, subset selection, or commitment.

title: State Qualification Result
description: Canonical, independently identifiable and traceable result of evaluating whether governance-relevant information is suitable for inclusion in or use as Canonical State for a defined evaluation horizon. The result records freshness, provenance, completeness, consistency, integrity, availability, conflict resolution, and ordering suitability; distinguishes qualified, not-qualified, and indeterminate outcomes; and prevents admissibility from proceeding when Canonical State suitability is not established.
rtm_mapping_basis: Relationship-specific semantic mapping approved for Canonical State availability, freshness, conflict resolution, and pre-admissibility State Qualification requirements in RTM-1.16.
notes: Extracted from the transitional State Qualification model embedded in DS-023. DS-032 now records qualified, not-qualified, and indeterminate outcomes; DS-023 accepts only the qualified outcome. Reverse schema dependency metadata synchronized to the active forward schema_dependencies graph in Schema Catalog 1.0.44.

title: Evidence Qualification Result
description: Canonical, independently identifiable and traceable result of determining whether the evidence required for a governance decision is sufficiently fresh, provenanced, integrity-verifiable, authoritative, resolvable, sufficient, and available for the specific proposal, action, target, tenant, policy, and evaluation horizon. Evidence that is not qualified cannot support admissibility or authority merely because an artifact or reference exists.
rtm_mapping_basis: Relationship-specific semantic mapping approved for evidence provenance, reference resolvability, sufficiency, integrity, change detection, availability, and pre-admissibility Evidence Qualification requirements in RTM-1.17.
notes: Canonical DS-033 Evidence Qualification result. The schema externalizes the transitional shared model, adds mandatory availability qualification, supports qualified, not-qualified, and indeterminate outcomes, and supplies the canonical qualified_evidence_ref used by active governance schemas. Reverse schema dependency metadata synchronized to the active forward schema_dependencies graph in Schema Catalog 1.0.44.

title: Authority Re-Derivation Result
description: Canonical, independently identifiable and traceable result of re-deriving proposal-specific authority immediately before commitment from current qualified governance inputs. The result evaluates current Canonical State, Authority Lineage, Delegation Artifacts, Governance Approval Artifacts, qualified evidence, authorization, target, tenant, governance domain, lifecycle, scope, validity, revocation, subject eligibility, recursive containment, and cross-domain isolation. It precedes Commit-Bound Admissibility and Governance Binding Validation and does not itself grant permission to execute.
rtm_mapping_basis: Relationship-specific semantic mapping approved for current tenant and subject status, non-portable prior authorization, current Canonical State, continued governing assumptions, direct commit-time Authority Re-Derivation, Recursive Authority Containment, and Cross-Domain Authority Isolation requirements in RTM-1.18.
notes: Canonical DS-034 commit-time Authority Re-Derivation result. It consumes current qualified Canonical State and evidence, Authority Lineage, Delegation Artifacts, Governance Approval Artifacts, authorization, target, tenant, lifecycle, scope, validity, revocation, recursive-containment, and cross-domain conditions. It is proposal-specific, non-portable, and precedes Commit-Bound Admissibility and Governance Binding Validation.

title: Bind Set
description: Canonical, independently identifiable and traceable complete candidate collection of governed sub-transitions evaluated as a coordinated governance unit. A Bind Set preserves parent and sub-transition identity, target, Tenant, governance domain, declared coupling semantics, Governance Dependency Graph binding, aggregate-effect basis, and partial-binding policy. It supplies the complete evaluation context for coordinated binding but does not itself establish authority, authorize execution, determine Partial-Bind Admissibility, or approve an executable subset.
rtm_mapping_basis: Relationship-specific semantic mapping approved for composite proposal representation, explicit coupling classification, and governed partial-bind consideration in RTM-1.20.
notes: Canonical DS-035 complete candidate Bind Set. It preserves parent/sub-transition identity, targets, authority domains, coupling semantics, DS-036 dependency-graph binding, aggregate-effect basis, and declared partial-binding policy. It does not establish authority, authorize execution, determine Partial-Bind Admissibility, or approve an executable subset.

title: Governance Dependency Graph
description: Canonical, independently identifiable and traceable structured representation of governance-significant dependency, prerequisite, ordering, authority, synchronization, consistency, execution, resource, policy, evidence, and state relationships among governed sub-transitions of a composite proposal. The graph makes dependencies explicit for composite evaluation, re-evaluation, Governance Binding Validation, Deterministic Adjudication, Partial-Bind Admissibility, Resulting-State Validation, coordinated enforcement, and replay. It does not itself establish authority, authorize execution, or determine partial-bind admissibility. Commit-sensitive dependency evaluation is performed by the Governance Realization Function as part of Commit-Bound Admissibility; the dependency graph is descriptive input and does not itself commit or enforce.
rtm_mapping_basis: Relationship-specific semantic mapping approved for explicit Governance Dependency Graph preservation and deterministic pre-bind re-evaluation following material dependency-condition change in RTM-1.19.
notes: Canonical DS-036 Governance Dependency Graph extracted from DS-021. It models explicit governed sub-transition nodes and typed dependency relationships, requires attributable graph validation and replay material, and mandates deterministic pre-bind re-evaluation after material dependency-condition change. It does not itself establish authority, authorize execution, or determine partial-bind admissibility.

title: Deterministic Adjudication Result
description: Canonical, independently identifiable and traceable result of resolving which candidate, if any, may proceed toward commitment when multiple currently admissible transitions contend within the same governance horizon. The result operates on a complete Admissible Set and applies explicit governance-significant ordering, conflict, dependency, resource, priority, state, and policy conditions rather than arrival timing or implementation-specific behavior. It may select one properly bound transition, a validated executable subset, no candidate, or an indeterminate outcome. It contributes to Governance Evidence and commitment processing but does not itself establish authority, authorize execution, validate Governance Binding, or commit a transition. Adjudication remains subject to Governance Realization current admissibility and PEP mediation at the Commit Boundary.
rtm_mapping_basis: Exact DS-to-requirement assignments derived from the authoritative RTM-1.47 DS_ID column; the catalog records the corresponding RTM_ID and CR_ID sets without omission or addition.
notes: Canonical DS-037 Deterministic Adjudication Result. It preserves a complete Admissible Set and resolves contention through explicit governance-significant ordering, conflict, dependency, resource, priority, state, and policy conditions. It prohibits arrival timing and implementation-specific behavior as governance bases and does not itself authorize, bind, or commit a transition. RTM/CR traceability synchronized to RTM-1.47 by adding RTM-00034 and CR-034.

title: Governance Lifecycle Record
description: Canonical attributable, integrity-protected record of a Governed Action Proposal lifecycle. DS-038 derives authoritative lifecycle state from ordered Governance Ledger records, preserves complete transition history and transition basis, distinguishes terminal from nonterminal state, records approval, refusal, expiration, cancellation, degradation, re-evaluation, recovery, commitment, and execution effects, and binds every lifecycle fact to stable Proposal Identity. It is not an uncontrolled mutable operational status flag and does not itself authorize execution. The lifecycle distinguishes commitment acceptance from later execution completion when operational realization is asynchronous.
rtm_mapping_basis: Direct semantic implementation of externally retrievable Derived Lifecycle State, exclusion of transient internal state, permitted transition integrity, lifecycle-eligible approval use, expiration and cancellation, terminal non-repeatable execution, provenance continuity, escalation integration, lifecycle integrity, and nonterminal degraded-state semantics.
notes: Implemented for AGCP v2.0. DS-038 owns lifecycle record, lifecycle state, transition, terminality, and canonical lifecycle reference definitions. It derives lifecycle state from ordered ledger records, preserves complete transition basis and history, blocks transient-state exposure, makes executed Proposal Identity terminal and non-repeatable, and records degradation and governed re-evaluation without itself authorizing execution. Reverse schema dependency metadata synchronized to the active forward schema_dependencies graph in Schema Catalog 1.0.44.

title: Continuation Integrity Result
description: Canonical attributable and integrity-protected result of Continuation Integrity processing for a nonterminal Governed Action Proposal before final Commit-Bound Admissibility is resolved. DS-039 verifies that the proposal-specific governance basis remains current, synchronized, and sufficiently qualified; evaluates material governance-condition changes and affected-proposal selection under active risk-based governance configuration; tracks Admissible Path Viability; records degradation, commitment suspension, governed re-evaluation, recovery, restoration, or terminal disposition; preserves Proposal Identity and governance lineage; and prevents prior authorization from being treated as unconditional future execution authority. It does not itself authorize execution, establish authority at commitment, bypass Commit-Bound Admissibility, or commit a transition. IAS account/role/entitlement changes map to AUTHORITY_CHANGE. IAS Profile or PEP Profile selection/mapping changes map to GOVERNANCE_CONFIGURATION_CHANGE.
rtm_mapping_basis: Direct semantic implementation of degraded-state detection, nonterminal degradation, required re-evaluation before authorization retention or commitment, continuation-basis preservation, admissible-path viability, degradation detection, governed recovery, composite dependency re-evaluation, and active risk-based re-evaluation.
notes: Implemented for AGCP v2.0. DS-039 owns Continuation Integrity result identity, outcomes, path-viability status, degradation, material-change assessment, risk-based re-evaluation, recovery, and canonical result references. It applies only to nonterminal pre-commit proposals and cannot authorize execution or bypass Commit-Bound Admissibility.

title: Governance Ledger Event
description: Canonical attributable, append-only, integrity-linked, totally ordered Governance Ledger event. DS-040 records or references governance submissions, context and state records, evidence and qualification results, authority and approvals, decisions and authorizations, refusals, commitments, enforcement outcomes, lifecycle transitions, continuation events, governance compilation and activation, and associated evidence. It preserves authoritative event ordering within an explicit ledger stream, supports per-proposal and dependent-event reconstruction, Derived Lifecycle State, deterministic replay, audit reconstruction, tenant isolation, cryptographic integrity, correction by subsequent event rather than mutation, and long-term verification. Timestamps, arrival order, storage order, node identity, and transport behavior are never authoritative ordering bases. A Governance Ledger event records governance history; it does not itself establish authority at commitment, authorize execution, alter the referenced artifact, or replace qualified authoritative sources used to resolve Canonical State.
rtm_mapping_basis: Exact DS-to-requirement assignments derived from the authoritative RTM-1.47 DS_ID column; the catalog records the corresponding RTM_ID and CR_ID sets without omission or addition.
notes: Implemented for AGCP v2.0. DS-040 owns Governance Ledger identity, event identity, event type, authoritative ledger position, append-only and hash-chain controls, explicit causal ordering, typed artifact references, correction-by-subsequent-event semantics, retention events, and canonical event references. It is not a general application log and does not itself authorize execution or replace authoritative Canonical State sources. RTM/CR traceability synchronized to RTM-1.47 by adding RTM-00008;RTM-00009;RTM-00034 and CR-008;CR-009;CR-034.

title: Governance Configuration
description: Canonical, independently identifiable, attributable, versioned, integrity-protected, and evaluation-available representation of all governance-significant configuration applicable to a defined Tenant, governance domain, scope, and Governance Version. It makes runtime governance settings explicit, prohibits hidden or implicit configuration from influencing governance decisions, preserves controlled change and activation requirements, and includes the active deterministic risk-based re-evaluation configuration used to identify affected nonterminal proposals when material governance conditions change. Governance Configuration does not itself establish authority at commitment, authorize execution, or activate compiled governance.
rtm_mapping_basis: Direct semantic implementation of configuration transparency, controlled self-modification isolation, and active risk-based re-evaluation configuration.
notes: Implemented for AGCP v2.0. Canonical reference ownership moved from common.json to DS-041. Active configurations require explicit settings, deterministic risk-based re-evaluation rules, external change control, integrity, availability, and controlled activation binding. Reverse schema dependency metadata synchronized to the active forward schema_dependencies graph in Schema Catalog 1.0.44.

title: Compiled Governance Artifact
description: Canonical, independently identifiable, versioned, attributable, traceable, integrity-protected, machine-evaluable output of Governance Compilation. It preserves the originating governance intent and all applicable constraints, invariants, refusal paths, escalation semantics, evidence requirements, authority rules, commit meaning, compilation context, dependency set, and derivation lineage. It records Constitutional Validation, Governance Omission Analysis, Governance Self-Protection, and activation eligibility, but does not itself establish authority at commitment, determine Commit-Bound Admissibility, authorize execution, or activate governance.
rtm_mapping_basis: Direct semantic implementation of Governance Compilation, Compiled Governance Artifact, Constitutional Validation, constitutional safeguard preservation, Governance Self-Protection, and Governance Omission Analysis.
notes: Implemented for AGCP v2.0. DS-042 owns the Compiled Governance Artifact identifier and reference. It records deterministic compilation, semantic preservation, complete lineage, constitutional validation, omission analysis, self-protection, and activation eligibility without itself activating governance or authorizing execution.

title: Controlled Governance Activation
description: Canonical, independently identifiable, version-controlled, attributable, integrity-protected record of the governed operation through which an externally approved and constitutionally validated governance package becomes authoritative for runtime evaluation. It establishes package identity, Governance Version, provenance, approval, effective scope, activation evidence, atomicity, prior-version preservation, and rollback basis as one coherent operation. It remains distinct from execution authorization, Commit-Bound Admissibility, and transition commitment.
rtm_mapping_basis: Direct semantic implementation of pre-activation validation, protected-governance preservation at activation, atomic Controlled Governance Activation, prior-version preservation, rollback, and externally authorized self-modification isolation.
notes: Implemented for AGCP v2.0. DS-043 owns the Controlled Governance Activation record and reference. It requires a complete DS-042 package, external DS-026 approval, successful constitutional validation and omission analysis, atomic activation, Governance Version establishment, prior-version preservation on failure, rollback basis, activation evidence, provenance, integrity, and replay material.

title: AGCP Registry Document
description: Canonical validator for AGCP controlled-registry documents. It binds stable registry and entry identity, release and lifecycle state, integrity, direct entry-level NS/CR traceability, release-level architectural traceability, registry rules, field definitions, and typed entries without allowing a registry to alter Core normative behavior independently.
rtm_mapping_basis: Direct structural validation for registry documents and contextual support for governing-constraint identification, deterministic evaluation, and Governance Compilation registry-release binding.
notes: Implemented for AGCP v2.0 registry cleanup. DS-044 owns canonical registry-document and registry-reference definitions. Authoritative payloads reside only under registries/ and include release, lifecycle, integrity, traceability, and typed-entry controls. Entry-level REG identifiers and direct NS/CR traceability are now mandatory for typed and generic registry entries.

title: Governance Approval Submission
description: Untrusted ingress command for submitting approval, adjudication, cosignature, risk-acceptance, cancellation, withdrawal, or quorum-participation content to AGCP. The submission carries claimant-provided content and provenance only. It is not a Governance Approval Artifact, does not establish verification, eligibility, quorum completion, lifecycle effect, Canonical State qualification, authority, ledger ordering, or permission to execute.
rtm_mapping_basis: Direct IF-001 ingress mapping for approval, adjudication, cosignature, quorum, cancellation, withdrawal, and escalation commands; DS-045 is untrusted submission content and DS-026 remains the authoritative record.
notes: Implemented for P0-06 command-versus-authoritative-record separation. DS-045 accepts claimant content and provenance only; additionalProperties:false rejects AGCP-derived verification, eligibility, quorum, lifecycle, evidence, digest, replay, and ledger assertions. IF-001 accepts DS-045 and never accepts DS-026 as request content.

title: AGCP Governance Observation Event
description: Read-only attributable observation emitted by an AGCP Governance Observation Point. Observation records support correlation to management/test-control causes and to the authoritative runtime sources actually consumed by governed processing.
rtm_mapping_basis: Supporting management/test-control schema introduced by AGCP v2.1.0; no independent CR/RTM mapping is created solely by this supporting interface artifact.
notes: v2.1.0 corrected management-plane contract: observations support test-scope/correlation/condition/source binding.

title: AGCP Management Capabilities Response
description: Machine-readable discovery of implemented observation, actuation, and test-control capabilities, including whether each advertised surface is actually bound to governed runtime processing rather than merely accepting or recording requests. Runtime binding declarations are truth claims: BOUND is permitted only when the corresponding source or actuation adapter is connected to the ordinary governed runtime path and has passed the supporting coupling checks.
rtm_mapping_basis: Supporting management/test-control schema introduced by AGCP v2.1.0; no independent CR/RTM mapping is created solely by this supporting interface artifact.
notes: v2.1.0 corrected contract: truthful BOUND/RECORD_ONLY/UNBOUND discovery and source/actuation readback requirements.

title: AGCP Governance Actuation Request
description: Authenticated management request to introduce a typed controlled governance input or administrative transition without directly mutating downstream governance results. requested_condition is type-bound to actuation_type.
rtm_mapping_basis: Supporting management/test-control schema introduced by AGCP v2.1.0; no independent CR/RTM mapping is created solely by this supporting interface artifact.
notes: v2.1.0 corrected management-plane contract: actuation payloads are type-specific.

title: AGCP Governance Actuation Result
description: Result and readback record for a Governance Actuation Request. Request acceptance is explicitly distinct from authoritative realization. A 2xx response or acceptance_status=ACCEPTED does not mean the requested condition is effective.
rtm_mapping_basis: Supporting management/test-control schema introduced by AGCP v2.1.0; no independent CR/RTM mapping is created solely by this supporting interface artifact.
notes: v2.1.0 corrected management-plane contract: acceptance and authoritative realization are separate.

title: AGCP Test Control Request
description: Explicit test-only request to establish or reset an isolated conformance-test condition. Every non-reset control has a type-specific fixture payload and may establish inputs only, never the expected governance conclusion.
rtm_mapping_basis: Supporting management/test-control schema introduced by AGCP v2.1.0; no independent CR/RTM mapping is created solely by this supporting interface artifact.
notes: v2.1.0 corrected contract: typed non-reset controls; optional correlation_id is omitted when absent and JSON null is prohibited.

title: AGCP Test Control Result
description: Attributable result and readback record for an isolated AGCP test control. Acceptance, effective runtime binding, and observed consumption are separate states. EFFECTIVE means the scoped runtime source adapter will consume the condition for matching governed requests; it does not mean the condition has already been exercised.
rtm_mapping_basis: Supporting management/test-control schema introduced by AGCP v2.1.0; no independent CR/RTM mapping is created solely by this supporting interface artifact.
notes: v2.1.0 corrected contract: acceptance/effect/consumption separation; optional correlation_id is omitted when absent and JSON null is prohibited.

title: Governed Execution Outcome
description: Canonical attributable post-commit operational outcome for a governed transition. It distinguishes commitment from later target realization, including asynchronous, partial, failed, cancelled, or indeterminate operational outcomes.
rtm_mapping_basis: Exact DS-to-requirement assignments synchronized from authoritative RTM-1.47 DS_ID rows.
notes: Separates commitment from post-commit operational execution.

title: Identity and Authorization Qualification Result
description: Canonical result of resolving an authenticated subject against the implementation-selected Identity and Authorization Store Profile. It records authoritative identity, account status, tenant/domain relationships, roles, groups, entitlements, governance authorization attributes, reviewer classes, scope, validity, freshness, revocation state, source basis, and qualification evidence. These authorization and entitlement attributes are governance inputs and are not AGCP Execution Authorization.
rtm_mapping_basis: Exact DS-to-requirement assignments synchronized from authoritative RTM-1.47 DS_ID rows.
notes: Authoritative identity/account/authorization/entitlement qualification; distinct from Execution Authorization.
